sections.text: Read-through caching is on for the product catalogue as of this morning.
Worth knowing how it behaves: a miss under load is more expensive than no cache at all, because you pay the lookup and then pay the origin anyway.
That means the dangerous moment is not steady state, it is the thirty seconds after a deploy flushes the keys — every request misses at once and the origin sees a spike it never sees otherwise.
Practically: if you are deploying this week, deploy outside the lunch peak, and tell me if you see origin latency above 300ms.
We will move to staggered expiry next sprint, which removes the flush spike entirely.
